text_candidates.definitions: Every maximal printable run of at least 4 Unicode characters in each stated whole-file decoding view. Invalid UTF-8/GB18030 bytes and invalid UTF-16 surrogates split runs. Both UTF-16 byte alignments are scanned. Shorter runs are counted explicitly, not emitted. Candidate strings are not proof of intentional text or executable behavior.
text_candidates.semantic_warning: Encoded/random data creates plausible printable candidates. Strings and import presence are API/text clues, not execution proof. Incidental Lua/QQ fragments do not prove those subsystems.

companion_log.normalization: Remove timestamp; replace hex and numeric tokens. Full raw messages stay in task Temp. Pattern count is not a feature count.
companion_log.trust: Low-trust software self-report. Log was live and later appends are outside this snapshot.

limitations: Five original sections have zero file raw size; protected/high-entropy .Svo holds almost all file payload.
Exports and one TLS callback target virtual addresses without original file-backed bytes.
No protector vendor, decoded original instructions, complete control flow or every game feature was established.
A manifest-only resource directory does not rule out protected/embedded image/audio assets.
Import symbols do not prove reachable or executed behavior; log entries are self-report, not an independent trace.
Text extraction reports explicit minimum character length and all shorter-run counts; it cannot recover encrypted/packed text or every possible encoding.
Static map fields and saved configuration are not current cooldown, actual damage, visibility, resources or active user settings.
No transfer of memory writes, injection, input automation, platform modification, identity collection or network actions was performed.

historical_sample_identity_checks.scope: Complete current-file hashes matched explicit original-sample hash declarations in repository reports. This establishes current sample identity for reusing those historical static findings within their stated limits; historical analyses were not rerun or independently re-proven.
